scope: Xitter on the existing ST-iPhonie forum, stable worldbook identities and random guest registration

unitTests.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/network-identities.test.ts tests/xitter.test.js tests/phone-device-settings.test.ts tests/phone-game-clock.test.ts tests/no-japanese.test.ts

checks: opening and navigation do not generate content
profile-only email and public nickname/handle display
post and comment share account identity
like and unlike use the current saved post
CRYCHIC profile is dormant, viewable and followable
switching viewpoint keeps the same public feed identities
one explicit refresh creates a random guest using a fixed test reply
no page errors, external requests, nested buttons or horizontal overflow
browser.limitation: Isolated actual phone UI/backend/parser and world actions; fixed generation fixture, not a full Tavern or Tauri device session.

visualInspection.method: Pillow crop and supersampled alpha mask; no image generation
